mapper.select: SELECT coupon_no AS couponNo, coupon_name AS couponName, discount_type AS discountType, discount_value AS discountValue, delete_yn AS deleteYn, created_at AS createdAt FROM coupon WHERE delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon (coupon_no, coupon_name, discount_type, discount_value, delete_yn, created_at) VALUES (seq_coupon.nextval, #{couponName}, #{discountType}, #{discountValue}, 'N', SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon SET coupon_name = #{couponName}, discount_type = #{discountType}, discount_value = #{discountValue}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE coupon_no = #{couponNo}
UPDATE coupon SET delete_yn = 'Y', updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE coupon_no = #{couponNo}
mapper.select: SELECT mc.member_coupon_no AS memberCouponNo, mc.member_no AS memberNo, mc.coupon_no AS couponNo, mc.used_yn AS usedYn, mc.used_at AS usedAt, mc.issued_at AS issuedAt, mc.start_at AS startAt, mc.end_at AS endAt, c.coupon_name AS couponName, c.discount_type AS discountType, c.discount_value AS discountValue, m.member_id AS memberId, m.name AS memberName FROM member_coupon mc JOIN coupon c ON mc.coupon_no = c.coupon_no JOIN member m ON mc.member_no = m.member_no WHERE c.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY mc.issued_at DESC

SELECT mc.member_coupon_no AS memberCouponNo, mc.member_no AS memberNo, mc.coupon_no AS couponNo, mc.used_yn AS usedYn, mc.used_at AS usedAt, mc.issued_at AS issuedAt, mc.start_at AS startAt, mc.end_at AS endAt, c.coupon_name AS couponName, c.discount_type AS discountType, c.discount_value AS discountValue FROM member_coupon mc JOIN coupon c ON mc.coupon_no = c.coupon_no WHERE mc.member_no = #{memberNo} AND c.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY mc.issued_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_coupon (member_coupon_no, member_no, coupon_no, used_yn, issued_at, start_at, end_at) VALUES (seq_member_coupon.nextval, #{memberNo}, #{couponNo}, 'N', SYSTIMESTAMP, #{startAt}, #{endAt})
